bio: Akshay is a law student who has been working with COLLECTIVE organizations for the last 4-5 years. They run a library by the name of Sabki Library in Vasant Kunj (referenced in the article) where they work to educate the children of slum areas. They also run a marathon group by the name of Vasant Kun
name: Akshay

bio: Anjan Azad is a student of law at Jamia Millia Islamia and an activist currently serving as the convener of All India Revolutionary Students Organisation (AIRSO). His writings have previously appeared in publications like
name: Anjan Azad

bio: Dhairya Mishra is a final year student of Journalism Honours at Kalindi College, Delhi University. Her interests span across various domains, from business to fashion. She enjoys observing everyday occurrences and connecting them to deeper reflections of life. Through her writing, she aims to offer genuine insights into the complexities of our existence. With a "Let's try on a new lens" approach, she endeavors to carve out a meaningful presence in the field of journalism, changing the world, one thought at a time. This article is co-written by her & TVE Editor Mouli Sharma.
name: Dhairya Mishra

bio: Dipankar Ghose is a WHT Scholar from the University of Oxford. He is presently the Deputy National Editor at Hindustan Times, and previously worked with the Indian Express. He is a three time Ramnath Goenka Awardee, & received the Prem Bhatia Award for Journalism in 2020.
name: Dipankar Ghose

bio: Firaaq is a scholar of human rights and an independent journalist based in New Delhi. His work has appeared in publications likeNewClick,GroundXero, and Nutan Charcha.
name: Firaaq

bio: Kandarp is a 23-year-old journalism undergrad at the University of Delhi. Hailing from eastern UP. Kandarp is passionate about photography and filmmaking. He uses his art to address social issues, & currently works as an independent photographer. He & his work can be found @kandarpbhargav on Instagram.
name: Kandarp

bio: Kanika Solanki is currently a student at the University of Delhi, pursuing her bachelor's in journalism. She has a keen interest in photography and graphic designing & has previously interned as a content writer. The quest for gaining new information and experiences keeps her going.
name: Kanika Solanki

bio: Mayur Lookhar is the founder ofthe entertainment news website,Beyondbollywood.in, & has over 17 years of experience as an entertainment journalist. He has worked over his career for Times Now, IndianTelevision.com, Cinestaan, BestMediaInfo.com, Sportzinteractive.net, & CineBlitz [freelance] before founding his own portal.
name: Mayur Lookhar

bio: Mohit Gola is a student at Netaji Subhas University of Technology studying Electronic & Computer Engineering. He has worked as a graphic designer for NSUT's GDSC. He has always had an interest in art and photography, and constantly seeks avenues for creative fulfillment in his career opportunities through graphic design.
name: Mohit Gola

bio: Mouli Sharma is a journalist, freelance illustrator, and writer from New Delhi, India. She is a published photojournalist & illustrator, having been featured in The Hindu College Gazette, & the quarterly Pink Disco. Mouli took over as the Editor of The Voice Express (https://thevoiceexpress.github.io/e-mag/) back in September 2023.
name: Mouli Sharma

bio: Sourya is a PhD scholar at JNU & the General Secretary of COLLECTIVE’s Delhi branch.COLLECTIVEis a student-led non-profit working in areas of worker’s rights & political activism. Since 2017, COLLECTIVE has established a short but powerful portfolio of investigative journalism, including a fact-finding report on the horrificAnaj Mandi factory fire, where 43 people died. Its constitution & programme describe it as a ‘left-revolutionary’ student organisation.
name: Sourya

bio: Theodore Chao is an associate professor of Mathematics Education in the Department of Teaching and Learning at The Ohio State University. His research agenda involves engaging all students and teachers regardless of social identity (race, gender, socioeconomic status, etc.) to fully see themselves as mathematical humans, particularly through technology. Chao is currently an associate editor for Theory Into Practice (TIP), an editorial panel member of Mathematics Teacher Educator (MTE), a steering committee member of the North American Chapter of the International Group for the Psychology of Mathematics Education (PME-NA), and an organizer for the Free Minds, Free People (FMFP) conference.
name: Theodore Chao
